about: Nurse station modelled as a generic product: HPL public fascia with joints and quartz transaction ledge with LED strip, lowered accessible section with knee space and hearing loop sign, staff worktop with grommets, cable tray and a power/data module, 3-drawer pedestal facing the staff, return leg with ledge, worktop and base unit with doors, stainless plinths, end panel. Geometry is drawn at the 3600x2400_L type; the other types share it until a parametric pass. Reference: query: casework nurse station counter casework hospital; images: https://www.google.com/search?tbm=isch&q=casework+nurse+station+counter+casework+hospital; basis: generic product; brand, model and supplier open for review
